memorials.name: Marcus Olejnik
memorials.text: Marcus Olejnik - Mechanical Engineer. Kept the water flowing when no one else could. Died fixing the generator during the great blackout. 'The pipes never leaked on my watch.'

memorials.name: Elena Vasquez
memorials.text: Dr. Elena Vasquez - Chief Medical Officer. Saved countless lives with her skill and compassion. Died treating a radiation victim. 'We don't leave anyone behind.'

memorials.name: Suki Tanaka
memorials.text: Suki Tanaka - Farmer. Grew food when the earth was poisoned. Died protecting her greenhouse from raiders. 'The seeds must survive.'

memorials.name: Unknown Scavenger
memorials.text: Here lies a scavenger who gave their life for the bunker. We never knew their name, but we knew their courage. They died so we could live.

memorials.name: Black Flotilla Victim
memorials.text: A survivor who fell victim to the Black Flotilla's treachery. They trusted, they traded, they died. Remember: trust is a luxury we cannot afford.

memorials.name: Radiation Storm Victims
memorials.text: They sought shelter too late. The storm came and took them. Their names are lost to the wind, but their sacrifice reminds us: never hesitate when the alarms sound.

memorials.name: Raider Attack Victims
memorials.text: They fought to the last. Raiders came in the night, and these brave souls stood between us and annihilation. We remember their names in the dark.

memorials.name: Food Shortage Victims
memorials.text: They starved so others could eat. When the rations ran out, these survivors gave up their share. We will never forget their sacrifice.

memorials.name: Disease Outbreak Victims
memorials.text: The sickness came and took them. We tried to save them, but the disease was too strong. Their memory lives on in our vigilance.

memorials.name: Power Failure Victims
memorials.text: The generator failed, and the cold took them. We tried to repair it, but it was too late. Their deaths remind us: never neglect the machines that keep us alive.

memorials.name: First Leader
memorials.text: The one who first opened these doors to us. Without their leadership, we would have perished in the wasteland. Their vision lives on in these walls.

memorials.name: Meridian Compact Ally
memorials.text: A friend from the Meridian Compact who stood with us in our darkest hour. Their alliance brought us hope when we had none. We will not forget.

memorials.name: Scavenger Alliance Member
memorials.text: Once an enemy, they became a friend. Their knowledge of the wasteland saved us from starvation. A testament to redemption.

memorials.name: The Teacher
memorials.text: They taught our children when the world burned. Gave them knowledge when we had nothing else. Died passing on the last lesson. 'The future is in their hands.'

memorials.name: The Storyteller
memorials.text: They kept our spirits alive with tales of the old world. When we forgot who we were, they reminded us. Their stories live on in our hearts.

memorials.name: The Faithful Guard
memorials.text: They stood watch every night, never sleeping, never faltering. Died at their post, eyes still scanning the horizon. 'The bunker is safe.'

memorials.name: The Explorer
memorials.text: They ventured into the unknown to find what we needed. Their maps led us to safety, to food, to hope. Died beyond the horizon. 'There's always more to find.'

memorials.name: The Medic
memorials.text: Their hands healed countless wounds. They worked tirelessly, never resting. Died from exhaustion, but not before saving us all. 'Every life matters.'

memorials.name: The Builder
memorials.text: They turned our crumbling shelter into a fortress. Their hands built the walls that kept us safe. Died with a hammer in their hand. 'We build to last.'

memorials.name: The Farmer
memorials.text: They coaxed life from poisoned earth. Their crops fed us when we had nothing. Died defending their fields. 'The land gives, we must give back.'

memorials.name: The Scientist
memorials.text: Their mind solved problems we couldn't even understand. Their inventions saved us. Died in an experiment gone wrong. 'Knowledge is survival.'

memorials.name: The Child
memorials.text: Too young to understand the world they were born into. Their laughter reminded us of what we were fighting for. Taken by the wasteland's cruelty. 'We must protect the innocent.'

memorials.name: The Courier
memorials.text: They carried messages between settlements when no one else would. Their journeys connected us to the world. Died delivering hope. 'The message must get through.'

memorials.name: The Cook
memorials.text: They turned our meager rations into feasts. Their meals gave us strength. Died from starvation, having given their share to others. 'Food is love.'

memorials.name: The Musician
memorials.text: Their songs reminded us of beauty in this broken world. Their music gave us comfort in the dark. Died playing their last note. 'The song never ends.'

memorials.name: The Leader
memorials.text: They guided us through the darkest times. Their decisions saved us from destruction. Died leading the defense. 'The bunker comes first.'

memorials.name: Unknown Hero
memorials.text: We don't know their name, but we know their courage. They died saving a child from raiders. Their identity is lost, but their heroism is not.
